scripts.build: bun run --filter @hannibox/web build && bun run --filter @hannibox/api build
scripts.preview: bun run --filter @hannibox/web build && bun run --filter @hannibox/api dev
scripts.deploy: bun run --filter @hannibox/web build && bun run --filter @hannibox/api deploy
scripts.db:generate: bun run --filter @hannibox/auth schema && bun run --filter @hannibox/db generate
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run fmt:check
